summary_en: 30M shares (1.34% of S/O ex-treasury) | ¥50.0B upper limit | Execution window 2026-08-03 to 2027-01-31 | Market purchase via discretionary investment contract on Tokyo Stock Exchange | Rationale: capital efficiency and flexible capital policy execution.
title_en: Notice regarding the decision of matters related to acquisition of treasury shares (share repurchase authorization under the Companies Act Article 156 paragraph 1, based on Articles of Incorporation Article 50 stipulations under Companies Act Article 459 paragraph 1 item 1)
translation_en_brief: Resona Holdings announced on July 31, 2026 that its board of directors has authorized a share repurchase under Article 156 of the Companies Act, based on the discretionary investment framework defined in Article 50 of the Articles of Incorporation. The company will acquire up to 30 million ordinary shares (1.34% of shares outstanding excluding treasury stock) for an aggregate consideration not to exceed ¥50.0 billion. The repurchase will be executed via open-market purchase through discretionary investment contracts on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between August 3, 2026 and January 31, 2027. The stated purpose is to improve capital efficiency and enable flexible and timely capital management.
